speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger; to help me understand your condition, how long has this been happening and was there a specific injury?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Boxed Fracture of the Right Ring Finger (likely hook of hamate or proximal phalanx) due to direct traumatic injury during football. I recommend an X-ray of the right hand to confirm the fracture and rule out joint dislocation. REQUEST IMAGES: Right_Hand_XRay

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
